title: Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders Return Windows and Return Authorization Validity
content:
Return windows for Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders are counted in calendar days after the order was completed. They are the same for every fulfillment method except where the table shows otherwise.

## Return window by item category (calendar days after completion)

| Item category | Standard Ship-to-Home | Expedited Ship-to-Home | Buy Online Pick Up In Store | Curbside Pickup | Same-Day Delivery | Large Item Freight Delivery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Food | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Treats | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Supplies | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Toys | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Aquatics equipment | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Large furniture | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Gift card | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) | 0 (not returnable) |

## Other return terms by method

| Term | Standard Ship-to-Home | Expedited Ship-to-Home | Buy Online Pick Up In Store | Curbside Pickup | Same-Day Delivery | Large Item Freight Delivery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Holiday extension: orders placed 1 November to 24 December may be returned until 31 January of the following year when that is later | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Opened food or treats refunded under the satisfaction guarantee (calendar days after completion) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Defective item, including a final-sale item, may be returned (calendar days after completion) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Final-sale items returnable other than as defective | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Return authorization validity: calendar days after authorization within which the item must be dropped at a store or handed to the carrier | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 21 |

## Notes

- A window of 0 days means the category is not returnable; gift cards carry 0 on every method.
- The holiday extension runs from purchase dates 1 November through 24 December, with returns accepted until 31 January of the following year when that date is later.
- The return authorization stays valid 14 calendar days on every method except Large Item Freight Delivery, where it is 21.
